title: USPTO Open Data Portal (patent applications, PTAB, petitions, bulk datasets)
agency: United States Patent and Trademark Office (U.S. Department of Commerce)
questions: patents granted to a company in a year
status and history of a patent application
PTAB inter partes review proceedings for a patent
patent applications filed in a CPC class over time

manual.how: The ODP API needs a key in the X-API-KEY header, so browser links do not work: on your own computer run download_data.sh / download_data.ps1 from manual_download/ (one command; it asks for USPTO_API_KEY with hidden input), then upload the JSON files. Without a key: sign in at https://data.uspto.gov (USPTO.gov account with MFA, required since 2026-06-18), open Patent File Wrapper search (https://data.uspto.gov/patent-file-wrapper/search), run the query, download the results as JSON or CSV and upload them.

cache.why: Application data are refreshed daily; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: Patent bibliographic data published by the USPTO are U.S. government information, not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. 105; USPTO terms of use at https://www.uspto.gov/terms-use-uspto-websites). Records name inventors, attorneys and addresses: report aggregates, not people.

citation: United States Patent and Trademark Office, Open Data Portal API, {dataset}, api.uspto.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
